decisions.reason: As a carpet closely related to the firm’s interior offering, its continued dedicated web presence through 2024 suggests the firm can use existing material and design know-how to refine and commercialize it successfully.

This hand-knotted wool-silk carpet fits the firm’s established competence in premium interior products, and its sustained standalone presentation indicates enough market traction to justify further learning and improvement.
Although close to the existing range, its disappearance from the website by 2024 signals weak enough results that the firm would likely reallocate resources to better-performing adjacent products.

The corner bench builds directly on the firm’s furniture capabilities, and even with lighter 2024 visibility its continued mention suggests management sees scope to improve it through existing seating and customization knowledge.
This low-pile carpet remains on its own page in 2024, and because it is highly related to the firm’s established assortment the firm is well placed to interpret feedback and enhance it further.

The swivel shell chair is strongly aligned with the firm’s core furniture and workplace expertise, and its continued dedicated presence indicates a product the firm can support and develop with existing capabilities.
